examples.arabic: بعد عشر دقائق سالت الجرسون كيف حالك يا اخي
examples.english: After ten minutes, I asked the waiter, 'How are you, my brother?'
examples.transliteration: Ba'da 'ashri daqa'iq sa'altu al-jarsuna, 'Kayfa haluka ya akhi?'

examples.arabic: بعد دقائق ساله الجار القديم عفوا ما اسمك مرة اخرى
examples.english: After a few minutes the old neighbor asked him 'Excuse me what's your name again'
examples.transliteration: Ba'da daqa'iq sa'alahu al-jaru al-qadim 'afwan ma ismuka marratan ukhra
examples.storyTitle: New Neighbors and a Weak Memory

examples.arabic: لكن في الدقائق الاخيرة احرز فريقه هدفا آخر وفاز بالمباراة
examples.english: But in the last minutes, his team scored another goal and won the match.
examples.transliteration: Lakin fi ad-daqa'iq al-akheerah ahraza fareequhu hadafan aakhar wa faaz bi-al-mubaaraah.
